sources.shortCitation: Musée SACEM, creator record for Léo Lelièvre (fils)
sources.fullCitation: Société des auteurs, compositeurs et éditeurs de musique. “Léo Lelièvre (fils).” Musée SACEM, Les créateurs. Born 9 June 1899 in Paris, died 21 June 1966 in Prague; admitted to SACEM as author on 13 November 1919 and as composer on 21 April 1927, elected full member in 1927; Prix Ferny, 1939. Accessed 25 August 2026.
sources.title: Léo Lelièvre (fils)
sources.creator: Société des auteurs, compositeurs et éditeurs de musique
sources.researchNote: The society through which both men licensed their work distinguishes the son by the qualifier “fils” and dates his membership from 1919, ten years before the first Casino de Paris covers that carry that qualifier. The place of death, Prague, is recorded here alone among the authority files consulted.
